Multi-model median change (bars) and inter-model interquartile range (whiskers) in precipitation characteristics for 2021–2050 relative to each model's own bias-corrected baseline (1995–2014). The whiskers show inter-model spread, not a confidence interval. The number beneath each bar is the inter-model agreement fraction; bold marks agreement of at least 80%, and those bars are filled solid.

As the previous figure, for the extreme-rainfall indices: (a) intensity and threshold indices and (b) tail and persistence indices. CDD, CWD and Rx5day depend on the ordering of wet and dry days, which quantile mapping does not correct, and are reported as diagnostics rather than as corrected projections.

Ensemble median change in PRCPTOT for 2021–2050 relative to each model's own bias-corrected baseline. The shaded surface is an inverse-distance-weighted interpolation between the 13 gauges, clipped to the verified provincial boundary; the gauges themselves are drawn on top, sized by the inter-model agreement fraction, with filled symbols for agreement of at least 80% and open symbols below it.
